eventDetail.scope: The ACM/IEEE Joint Conference on Digital Libraries (JCDL 2025) focuses on advancing research and practice in digital libraries and related fields. The conference welcomes work on digital information discovery, organization, management, retrieval, reuse, and preservation. Topics of interest include but are not limited to, digital preservation, scholarly communication, metadata standards, open science, research data management, scientometrics, knowledge extraction, user behavior, digital curation, and digital humanities. JCDL 2025 will place a special emphasis on emerging technologies and methods, including the use of large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and machine learning for digital libraries. As a fully asynchronous virtual conference, it seeks to expand participation opportunities across geographic and institutional boundaries.
